title: Cross-SDK Backoff Configurator, Idempotency Semantics, and Retry Taxonomy
creator: Ariana Patel
description: Create a cross-language (Python/TypeScript/Go) design and implementation for: 1) a backoff configurator that exposes safe default profiles and runtime knobs, 2) clarified idempotency key semantics including dedup windows and guidance for streaming calls, and 3) a canonical retryable error taxonomy that SDKs and server runtime can share. Goal: reduce SRE incidents from client-side misconfiguration, make streaming resume ergonomics explicit, and give teams a clear migration path to consistent defaults across SDKs.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by SDK leads (Python/TS/Go) and runtime team
Backoff configurator library published in each SDK with at least three profiles: conservative, balanced, aggressive
Idempotency spec published with examples for unary and streaming endpoints, including code samples for generating and rotating id-keys
Retryable error taxonomy documented and added to runtime-to-sdk contract (error codes + recommended action: retry/never-retry/conditional-retry)
End-to-end integration test demonstrating stream resume using stable resume token + idempotency window
Migration guide and changelog entry created; rollout plan validated with staged release to beta users
implementation_notes: Backoff profiles expressed as small JSON/BSON blobs to allow runtime override in Dedicated/Private deployments
Default parameterization: initial_delay_ms, max_delay_ms, multiplier, jitter_fraction, max_retries, overall_timeout_ms
Provide idiomatic wrapper APIs: Python dataclass, TS typed interface, Go struct with functional options
Idempotency keys: recommend RFC4122 v4 UUID by default; include optional stable-key helper for client-supplied deterministic keys
Default deduplication window: 120s for unary requests unless customer config overrides; stream dedup window tied to last-ack timestamp + 30s grace period
Taxonomy buckets: transient_network, server_overload, rate_limit, model_unavailable, deterministic_client_error, non_retryable_parse_error
Map HTTP/gRPC status codes and runtime error codes to taxonomy with explicit examples (e.g., 429 -> rate_limit, 503 overloaded -> server_overload, 502/504 -> transient_network)
rollout_plan: Week 1: design review + proto libraries in monorepo; unit test matrix for Python/TS/Go
Week 2: merge SDK implementations behind feature flag; documentation draft on Console and DevDocs
Week 3: opt-in beta release to 5 internal teams; collect telemetry on retry counts, dedup hits, and stream resume success
Week 4: iterate defaults based on telemetry; prepare stable release and migration guide; announce via SDK release notes
Post-release: add console knob for per-customer backoff profile override and telemetry dashboard for retry events
comments: 2026-02-11 Marco Chen: Initial spike complete — prototype backoff-configurator that outputs JSON profiles. Observed 12% lower tail latency when switching default from aggressive -> balanced for short-request workloads.

2026-02-16 Lena Ortiz (runtime): We need a small server-side honor-check: do not retry model-timeout errors more than 1 time server-side even if client retries — to avoid thundering. Added as dependency for taxonomy mapping.
